name: unsafe fn from_encoded_bytes_unchecked (bytes : Vec < u8 >) -> Self
rule: The input bytes must originate as a mixture of validated UTF-8 and bytes from `OsStr::as_encoded_bytes` produced within the same Rust version built for the same target platform; bytes from `OsStr::as_encoded_bytes` may be split immediately before or immediately after any valid non-empty UTF-8 substring.
api: impl  std::ffi::os_str::OsString { unsafe fn from_encoded_bytes_unchecked (bytes : alloc::vec::Vec < u8 >) -> Self }
